messages.text: BL-1678 🎵 in progress — A LAND_CLEAN land pushes QA's whole branch tip as main, and the land step's sibling check covers only siblings that share a path with the landing ticket - so every forward QA has merged and not yet approved on OTHER paths ships unreviewed: BL-1640's bounced forward (its D1 defect included) reached origin/main at 12:42 under BL-1666's land on 2026-09-21, and origin/main's first-parent line is 375 'Merge ... into QA.' commits since 2026-08-22 (12 today); the land step judges every unlanded forward on the tip, the publish step lands a tip-pure commit of the landing ticket's own paths in every case, and a push whose new tip is a merge commit is refused
